note: A parallel window must match its originals' coverage and agreeing metadata. The per_column income entry is refused on a reference-period conflict, every field but the operational definition staying strict there (#1625); the shared outcome entry is refused on an operational-definition conflict, which only per-column metadata reconciles.
fails_if: `compile_parallel_representations` leaves `reference_period` out of the fields whose conflict between overlapping nested editions invalidates the entry, or reconciles an `operational_definition` conflict outside `column_metadata = "per_column"`

sources.description: Variable 1: First is pooled 2020-2022 (CVID 100) and again nested 2021-2022 (CVID 103); Second is 2022-2024 (CVID 101). The two First editions state contrary reference periods. Variable 2 repeats the shape with Third, Fourth and contrary operational definitions.
